helpIntro: UVA undergraduate GPA uses a 4.0 scale and is credit-weighted. Enter UVA credits and final grades; A+ and A both equal 4.0 points per credit.
helpNote: For standard undergraduate UVA coursework. External transfer grades are excluded. Direct-credit study abroad and repeat adjustments need record-aware review, so Repeat Impact is unavailable.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.0 grade points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.9; together, 21.9 ÷ 6 = 3.650.

gradeExplanations.F: F = 0 grade points; letter-graded credits remain in the GPA denominator.
gradeExplanations.NC: No Credit is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.P: Passing notation is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.IN: Incomplete is excluded until a final GPA-bearing grade is recorded.
gradeExplanations.IV: Invalid grade reported; excluded pending correction.
gradeExplanations.NG: Grade not reported; excluded pending final grade.
gradeExplanations.WD: Withdrawal notation is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.DR: Dropped without penalty; excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: UVA course, standard undergraduate grading
specialTypes.note: Enter UVA credits and the final undergraduate grade.

specialTypes.name: External transfer credit
specialTypes.note: Transfer credit may count toward the degree, but external grades do not enter the UVA GPA.

specialTypes.name: Direct-credit UVA study abroad
specialTypes.note: Direct-credit study abroad can enter UVA GPA; use the posted UVA record and school guidance.

specialTypes.name: Repeated UVA course needing GPA adjustment
specialTypes.note: Repeat treatment depends on original grade, timing, credits, and the first 9 qualifying repeated credits.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is disabled because UVA repeat treatment depends on the original grade, when the repeat was attempted, and the 9-credit adjustment limit. Use your SIS record or advising dean for the official effect.
